title: Dynamic Identity Handler and Object Inspector V1
features:
Game Compiler
Checks all parts and folders in the game and displays their path inside console.

The focus is on displaying various sections of a game, such as different services (Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, StarterGui, Ect) and their respective objects. The script inspects and outputs key information about these sections and their contents to the console. This can include:

Object names, types, and properties (size, position, etc.)
Information about game services and their objects
Displaying this data periodically for monitoring

This is just to help exploiters find assets in the game
